name: ship-silver-ship
summary: Silver hard-surface fighter: a pointed fuselage with a dark canopy and a wide bright spine deck, small swept fins by the canopy, and two side pods with red-striped engines at their backs.

traits: bright glint in the middle (col 11, row 6) is shine
set in a frame on top of the fuselage, raised 1-2 px
features.note: The cockpit canopy behind the nose: a dark glass bubble; must stay dark and glossy, distinct from the hull.

traits: pointed, tapering to a tip at row 0
bright centre line (col 11) is a ridge/sheen
features.note: The nose ahead of the canopy; tapers in width and height to a point.

traits: wide bright plate, 5 px wide, straight sides
flat top, raised above the pods
near-white spots (row 9, row 18) are sheen, not bumps
features.note: The bright central deck running from behind the canopy to the tail; a flat raised plate, not a bulging tube.

traits: wide side pod, about 6 px wide
lit diagonal edge at the front
features.note: Left side pod hugging the rear fuselage; must keep its angular front and its width.

traits: wide side pod, about 6 px wide
features.note: Right side pod, mirror of the left.

traits: red stripes at rows 18, 20, 22-25 with grey bands between (rows 19, 21)
red glows; bands are raised rings
features.note: Left red-striped engine at the back of the pod; red and grey bands must both read.

traits: red stripes with grey bands between
features.note: Right red-striped engine, mirror of the left.

traits: small swept fin, thin flat plate
features.note: Left swept fin beside the canopy; a thin sharp plate.

traits: small swept fin, thin flat plate
features.note: Right swept fin beside the canopy.

traits: three parallel ribs (cols 9, 11, 13), straight, constant width
features.note: Three ribs on the tail between the engines; must read as separate parallel ridges with dark slots between.
